build_yolos_object_detection: build a YOLOS object detection model with class logits and bounding box predictions for COCO detection tasks
run_yolos_model_forward: run the YOLOS ViT encoder model forward pass to extract hidden states and pooled output from image pixel values
create_yolos_embeddings: create patch, CLS token, detection token, and interpolated position embeddings for transformer input sequences
test_yolos_attention_layers: test the multi-head self-attention layers with query, key, value projections and residual connections
review_yolos_prediction_head: review the MLP prediction head that classifies object categories and predicts normalized bounding box coordinates
